name: HIVAU-70k
description: A large-scale benchmark for hierarchical video anomaly understanding across any granularity, providing multi-granular annotations at clip-level, event-level, and video-level segments to enable models to comprehend video anomalies over varying temporal scales and contexts.
reputation: A large-scale hierarchical video anomaly benchmark that is likely to attract interest in video understanding, but it is still relatively new.
notes: Includes a semi-automated annotation engine combining manual segmentation and LLM-based free-text annotation; benchmark supports multi-granular anomaly understanding and is publicly available.
